contract: Compare stream count and the audio entry's DTS classification, integral rate and samples per access unit from codec parameters after a MOV open, without stream discovery or packet decoding.

The candidate reports its core-signalling verdict and the sample entry's base rate. FFmpeg reports the DTS codec identifier and can use the maximum coded rate from ddts. A candidate entry refusal is distinct from a non-DTS entry.
The mismatched-format case passes an inconsistent typed format to the candidate's public checker and opens the original wire entry with FFmpeg.
Input loading and schedule parsing precede the operation. Both sides open, consume and release their readers inside it.
